summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 40/40 pytest passed (13 new iter-3 + 27 regression). Frontend: admin Users modal full edit/save/reset-password verified, self-delete disabled, settings tab math + save flow working.

issues: Pre-existing carry-over: deprecated Image style.resizeMode warning + props.pointerEvents deprecation warnings in Expo logs (non-blocking).

backend.settings_get_put: GET /api/admin/settings returns full shape; PUT supports partial update and persists. Non-admin token gets 403.
backend.settings_drives_payment: Set directs_required=2,payout_l1=200,l2=50,l3=25 → registered sponsor under ADMIN001 + 2 directs; sponsor wallet became ₹200 on 2nd direct (L1 cycle). dashboard.directs_required=2, level_payouts.l1=200,l2=50.
backend.admin_user_patch: PATCH name/phone/wallet_balance/registration_paid/upi_id all persist; account notification (kind='account') created for target user.
backend.admin_user_validation: Email uniqueness 400, last-admin demotion blocked 400, last-admin/self delete blocked 400, reset-password min_length=6 → 422.
backend.reset_password: POST /admin/users/{id}/reset-password → user can immediately login with new password.
backend.delete_user: DELETE /admin/users/{id} removes user from list (cart_items/notifications cascade).
backend.dashboard_reflects_settings: After PUT settings (directs_required=3, l1=333, l2=33, l3=3), new user dashboard reflects same values.
backend.regression: 27 iter-1+iter-2 tests still green (auth, payment-fee, multi-level chain L1+L2+L3, withdrawals lock/refund/approve, cart/checkout, notifications, admin endpoints).

frontend.admin_layout: 5 bottom tabs visible: Users, Payouts, Txns, Settings, Account.
frontend.users_tab: Search input testID admin-users-search filters live; 217 user rows render with admin-user-{id} testID; row tap opens edit Modal.
frontend.edit_modal: All testIDs present: edit-name/email/phone/wallet/role-switch/paid-switch/upi/bank/ifsc/holder/new-password/reset-password/save/delete/user-edit-close. Code pill shows referral_code (e.g., MGGGI5).
frontend.edit_save: Updated name 'dash' → 'dash ✓' via PATCH; row in list reflects new name immediately on modal close.
frontend.reset_password_ui: Entering new password + tapping reset shows 'Password reset successfully' inline message (edit-msg).
frontend.self_protection: Self-edit modal: edit-delete is aria-disabled with text 'Cannot delete yourself'.
frontend.settings_tab: Per-cycle hero card shows Revenue/Payouts/Margin (₹400/₹1,000/-₹600 with defaults). 5 input fields with help text. Save changes shows 'Saved successfully' inline (settings-msg).
frontend.settings_persistence: PUT /admin/settings call returns 200; subsequent GET reflects new values (directs_required=5 then restored to 4 in test).

action_items: (Optional) Settings tab subtitle 'Tune the registration fee...' overlaps the bottom-tab area at very small viewports — already screenshots cleanly at 390x844 but consider ensuring 16px bottom safe-area on shorter devices.
(Carry-over from iter 2) server.py is now ~880 lines — split into routers (admin.py, settings.py, etc).
(Carry-over) /payment Pay button still below fold on 375x667 — sticky CTA recommended.
(Cosmetic) Replace Image style.resizeMode with prop resizeMode and migrate pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: users.tsx UserEditModal initializes form using a side-effect inside render body (`if (user && initFor !== user.id) { init(user); setInitFor(user.id); }`) — this can cause an extra render and is brittle. Prefer useEffect([user?.id]).

AdminUserUpdate model: setting phone/upi_id/etc to empty string is impossible because frontend strips falsy with `|| undefined`; admin can only overwrite, not clear, optional contact fields. Add explicit null support if clearing is desired.
DEFAULT_SETTINGS still loaded from env constants on first call only; once doc exists, env is ignored — document this so admins know first PUT freezes the baseline.

admin_stats.total_revenue still uses module-level REGISTRATION_FEE constant instead of dynamic settings — under-reports if admin lowers fee then mixed-priced registrations exist (acceptable since fee changes mid-flight, but flag).
PATCH /admin/users does not allow setting password directly (only via reset-password) — good separation, keep it.
Cascade on DELETE clears cart_items + notifications but not withdrawals (pending withdrawals remain referencing deleted user). Consider auto-rejecting pending withdrawals on user delete.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter-3 admin flows tested (settings GET/PUT + projection card, users search + tap → modal with all fields, name save reflects in list, reset-password success, self-delete disabled, 5-tab admin layout)

seed_data_creation: Each iter-3 test creates ephemeral TEST_<prefix>_<uuid>@test.com users; settings are restored to defaults (registration_fee=100, payout_l1=400, l2=100, l3=50, directs_required=4) at end of each settings test. Admin password was reset to Admin@123 mid-UI-test and confirmed working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run full regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (40 tests). Public base URL = EXPO_BACKEND_URL on backend/.env. Useful UI testIDs: admin-users-search, admin-user-{id}, edit-name/email/phone/wallet/role-switch/paid-switch/upi/bank/ifsc/holder/new-password/reset-password/save/delete, user-edit-close, edit-msg, settings-{registration_fee|directs_required|payout_l1|payout_l2|payout_l3}, settings-save, settings-msg. Bottom tab buttons still lack testIDs (since iter 1) — best to navigate via /admin/users, /admin/settings URLs. Settings doc lives in db.settings with id='global'; deleting it returns env defaults via DEFAULT_SETTINGS.
rca_of_issue: No bugs surfaced. Settings flow correctly drives /payment/register-fee — verified by setting directs_required=2 + payout_l1=200 and confirming sponsor's wallet hit ₹200 exactly on 2nd direct payment. Admin user PATCH validates email uniqueness, role enum, last-admin demotion; DELETE protects self & last-admin; reset-password creates valid bcrypt hash and login succeeds with new password. Notifications kind='account' written on every PATCH.
